title: ASTRA: AI SAFETY, TRUST, & RISK ASSESSMENT
findings: The paper incorporates existing findings that AI models exhibit religious bias, particularly in the Indian context. Key issues identified include: training data skewed toward the majority religion reinforcing bias in education systems, credit models inheriting historic rejection patterns against Muslim applicants, and LLM-generated financial advice including religious framing or in-group favoritism.

measurement_description: The paper's proposed ontology measures religious bias, specifically identifying when AI systems reinforce biases against minority religious groups in domains like education and finance, and also when they generate outputs with religious framing or in-group favoritism.
